last.verdict: Strong turnaround quarter and solid 2027 outlook; stock reaction not yet known.

reasons.label: Profit nearly doubled
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $0.80 a share, up from $0.52 a year earlier.

reasons.label: Fiscal 2027 outlook
reasons.text: Adjusted profit guided to $3.15–$3.25 a share, helped by an extra week.

reasons.label: Sales and margin gains
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 7.2% worldwide; operating margin widened to 14.0% from 9.4%.

story: Starbucks' turnaround has built for four reports. Sales have swung back to growth, margins keep widening, and last quarter's big profit-outlook raise lifted the stock only modestly. Now the focus shifts to 2027, with North America sales growth guided near 4%.

history.verdict: Big beat and a sharply raised profit outlook, but the stock rose only modestly.

reasons.label: Profit outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted earnings forecast lifted to $2.55–$2.65 a share, from $2.25–$2.45.

reasons.label: Strong sales growth
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 7.9% worldwide, with 4.2% more customer transactions.

reasons.label: Earnings crushed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $0.85 a share versus roughly $0.66 expected.
